speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Singapore's research, innovation and enterprise (RIE) efforts will continue to play a key role in driving our future economy and addressing national and societal priorities.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Together with researchers, entrepreneurs, companies and Government agencies, the National Research Foundation (NRF) seeks to grow more innovative Singapore-based companies, create more good jobs and improve the lives of Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Singapore's international standings in both research and development (R&D) and in fostering innovation are strong.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: R&D in our universities and research institutes create economic and societal value for Singapore and enhance our quality of life.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Many companies, both foreign and local, recognise Singapore’s R&D value proposition and have deepened their R&D activities here.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We have a vibrant and growing ecosystem of startups, venture capitalists, incubators and accelerators, leveraging Singapore’s strengths as a financial centre and a trusted location to protect intellectual property.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: These are areas of both national need and existing scientific strengths for Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: While continuing to invest in academic excellence, we have sharpened our focus in research funding towards creating and capturing value from our R&D investments.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: This includes investing in research translation, facilitating innovation, and supporting startups and growth companies.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Stronger linkages across the value chain are enabling the flow-through of knowledge and technology from research into industry and community applications.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: The rapid growth in innovative high-technology enterprises in Singapore is encouraging more young Singaporeans to pursue careers built around science and technology.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: NRF will continue to harness our national research and innovation capabilities to enhance our economic competitiveness and provide greater opportunities for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: NRF will continue to support industry to get better at investing in new ideas and facilitate the flow-through of researchers into industry.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Budding entrepreneurs are matched with mentors, introduced to venture capital firms, and will be able to access R&D talent.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Together with other economic agencies, we will facilitate strategic partnerships among Singapore-based companies to expand their capabilities and help them access global markets.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to invest in growing a strong pool of science and engineering researchers, with links to the global community.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will refresh our strategic investments in major research centres in our universities and in our CREATE (Campus for Research Excellence and Technology Enterprise) collaborations with international partners, and continue to position Singapore as a global node of scientific excellence.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Our NRF Fellowships and Investigatorships continue to attract promising young scientists to conduct research in Singapore and provide opportunities for established scientists to pursue groundbreaking research.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Our Returning Singaporean Scientists scheme attracts overseas Singaporean scientists home to grow the core of Singaporean researchers and eventually take up leadership positions here.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In line with SkillsFuture, we will work with partner agencies and industry to increase the innovation and enterprise talent pool, identify key frontier skillsets in demand, and work with our Institutes of Higher Learning to train more Singaporeans for jobs in these fields.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Our RIE investments have created a strong foundation for the next stage of Singapore’s development.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We must continue to exploit new knowledge to diversify and create new industries, meet national and social needs, and create a Singapore with opportunities for all.

speaker: The Minister for Finance and Chairman of the National Research Foundation (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In a competitive world changing rapidly with technological advances, we must also remain connected to the world as a vibrant Global-Asia node of technology, innovation and enterprise.
